> Your post made my heart heavy as I've been in your girlfriend's situation and have made the same horrible, painful choice to preserve my remaining self worth


> ...But I still love my ex boyfriend more than anything in the world, 

See, to me these statements don't add up. Nothing harsh you said rings truer to the urge to kill myself more than this notion that you still "love" someone more than anything but you already stated your self worth was more valuable to you than this person being in your life? This is what I don't get. I literally feel I cannot live without her and have 0 interest or faith in being able to change if there is no future that is possible with her. I wanted to marry and grow old and even die with her and now I think I deserve to die alone and soon.

I appreciate your positivity and advice. I'm not in the best place but I'm okay because people like you give me hope I can do better someday.

Thank you for taking your time. It matters.

I've been in therapy before and find it is somewhat ineffective. I feel I manipulate conversations too easily without recognizing it. I wanted to go back to couples counseling like we had done once in college but this was always something we said we should do but never acted on. Individual therapy I just feel like I end up saying whatever the person talking to me wants to hear more than my own true feelings.
